---
name: Calculator correction
about: Report a non-sensitive calculator error or broken link.
title: '[Calculator] '
---

## Public report warning

This issue and its replies will be public. Do not include personal information,
real account details, financial documents, medical records, passwords or other
confidential information. This is not a private privacy-request or security
reporting channel. Do not post an email address or phone number for follow-up.

Use invented or anonymized numbers that reproduce the issue. Remove private
query parameters from URLs and private information from any attached image.

## Calculator URL

Provide the public calculator page URL, without sensitive query parameters.

## Steps and anonymous example inputs

Describe the steps and use made-up example values, not real personal records.

## Actual result

What result did the calculator show for those example values?

## Expected result and reference

Explain the expected calculation. Include a public formula or reference if one
is available; do not upload private documents as evidence.

## Public-information check

- [ ] I checked that this report and any attachments contain no personal,
  sensitive or confidential information.
